content.summary: This investigation conducted during the 12th Indian Antarctic Expedition examines key geology phenomena in polar terrain around Dakshin Gangotri and Dronning Maud Land. The study records baseline scientific parameters and contributes to long-term monitoring of environmental changes in Antarctica.
